items: Implementation commit and exact-HEAD CI/security certification
external_gates.qualification: Local combined suite and coverage are verified PASS; no READY/GO or exact implementation commit certification is inferred.

scope: Versioned typed intent, source transaction and outcome contracts

scopes.TENANT: organization_id required; P04 transactional tenant outbox; per-Organization chain
scopes.PLATFORM: organization_id null; immutable Sentinel source journal; separate platform chain and dedicated worker

contract.bounded_metadata: Declared UUID identifiers, finite enums, counts and versions; no generic blob
contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, finite numbers; timezone-aware time normalized to UTC
contract.source_identity: Semantic digest detects changed content under an existing source identity; sequence and persistence metadata belong to ledger authority

atomicity.claim: Registered SERVICE/customer-channel scope is bound only after P09 account resolution and signature/freshness validation. Downstream customer and conversation mutation-intent transactions retain that service actor. This does not claim one transaction covering all webhook processing.

atomicity.boundary: Local tenant mutation and audit intent
atomicity.claim: Same source transaction; insertion/provenance failure rolls back mutation.

Committed tool.execution.dispatch_authorized intent precedes I/O after P08 validation/claim. SUCCESS here means local dispatch authorization persisted, not remote completion. Later receipt and completion/failure intent share their own transaction; causation references operation UUID. Tool UUID/version only, no arguments/results in intent metadata.

TransactionalVaultClient and local ModelSecretStore share ciphertext/pointer/intent transaction. Unsupported external/nontransactional adapters fail before mutation; no external vault atomicity claim.

Existing Sentinel transaction inserts source intent; separate core worker appends ledger. Kill switch rollback on injected journal failure is proven. Privileged approval/claim/dispatch/completion intents retain platform attribution.

review.disposition: No open producer finding remains from final independent reinspection; final local combined suite and coverage passed. Clean-room and exact implementation commit external gates remain root obligations.

historical_findings.finding: Tool outcome-only audit left no durable attempt after external effect followed by local failure.
historical_findings.resolution: Committed pre-I/O dispatch authorization plus separately transactional outcome.

historical_findings.finding: Runtime failed/expired events defaulted SUCCESS and generic transitions omitted state.
historical_findings.resolution: Explicit failed outcome and finite state metadata.
